apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk, sideload it
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

## What's new
- VU: say what the fourth clamp rung carries
- vurunner: extend --vu-clamp-mode to mode 4
- VU: the multiplier's one-ULP deficit, on both emitters
- VU tests: encoders for the rest of the multiply family
- VU tests: score microVU on the two FMAC captures
- VU FMAC: take the saturated word's sign from the operands
- VU interp: keep the word an underflowing FMAC produced
- VU tests: what the FMAC leaves below 2^-126, from the console
- microVU: saturate the FMAC at the EE's maximum
- COP2 macro: saturate the FMAC at the EE's maximum
- microVU: read the EFU's models at vuClampMode 4
- VU: give the EFU one model entry point per opcode
- VU tests: score the divide unit across the clamp modes
- microVU: read the divide unit's arithmetic at vuClampMode 4
- COP2 macro: read the divide unit's arithmetic at vuClampMode 4
- VU: give the divide unit's model a recompiler calling convention
- VU tests: enable the MAC underflow tripwire
- VU tests: score microVU on the guard-mask capture
- microVU: mask the adder's guard bits
- VU: give the adder's guard mask one home
- microVU: raise the exact MAC U and MAC O
- VU: give the FMAC's MAC U and MAC O models one home
- VU tests: enable the macro status tripwire
- COP2 macro: raise MAC O on an overflowing FMAC
- microVU: the OP ops honour the dest field
- VU: the OP ops honour the dest field
- VU tests: measure the OP ops instead of asking about them
- COP2 macro: raise MAC U on an underflowing product
- microVU: take the div unit's zero tests off the host
- COP2 macro: take the div unit's zero tests off the host
- microVU: saturate the div unit at the EE's maximum
- EE FPU overflow tests: correct the header's stale engine columns
- COP2 macro: saturate the div unit at the EE's maximum
- COP2 macro: mask the adder's guard bits
- VU: give the clamp ladder a fourth rung
- VU: carry the multiply stage's sign into the sticky status field
- VU: measure the adder's guard mask on the console
- VU tests: wait for the running bit the way the console probe did
- VU interp: hold a D/T stop until the branch delay slot has run
- VU interp: match the EFU's atan and exp series to the console
- eerunner: report the engines --liverun actually ran on
- VU: evaluate the EFU's series in single precision
- VU interp: run the EFU on the EE FPU's model
- VU interp: narrow the FMAC pipe's status publish to its own bits
- VU0 macro: narrow CTC2's writes to the register widths
- eerunner: write a PNG per frame under --liverun
- VU interp: run the div unit on the EE FPU's model
- eerunner: run one VU on its interpreter under --liverun
- VU interp: run the FMAC on the EE FPU's model
- Tests: let a test record a divergence rather than drop the diff
- VU interp: raise U on a result that underflowed to zero
- COP2 macro: an operand clamp that keeps its sign
- COP2 macro: carry mVU_MUL's operand clamp on the whole MUL family
- EE rec: take the fallback bisect switch from the environment
- microVU: capture at the dispatcher's lookup, not past it

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260825...662b114168e1dc0be7b1354f948dbe0292f2a2ac
